caption: The drawing depicts a wooden frame structure with four vertical legs and a rectangular top surface, colored in shades of brown to represent wood. Inside the frame, there are ten vertically oriented metallic cylindrical pipes, colored in grayish-blue tones, evenly spaced and suspended from the top of the frame. Each cylinder has a pointed, conical bottom end. The construction is simple and functional, with the pipes fitting through holes in the top horizontal wooden bar and resting within the frame. The background is a plain, off-white or beige with slight discoloration and faint lines visible, providing no contextual setting. There is handwriting in the bottom right corner of the drawing, featuring the name "Eugene Orac" and some smaller, less legible text.
title: Candle Mold
